name: scheduling
deprecation_criterion: Superseded when scheduling moves to a different clock source (e.g. a native plugin cron API) or when the tick interval/route become config-driven and this slice's hardcoding is removed.
spec_change_reason: Adds the acted-ledger re-entry rule (§3.8.5-symmetric leak fix, auto-maintainer-framework#204): an already-'opened' work order re-enters the dispatch set when its auto-PR is closed-and-not-merged AND the source issue's updated_at advanced past the recorded acted_at_updated_at; otherwise it stays locked (merged / still-open / closed-but-unchanged). spec.md + contract.md (-> 0.10.0) describe the new acted-ledger entry field (acted_at_updated_at), the re-entry rule, and the injectable gh_pr_state_source PR-state seam (mirrors verify-integrate's gh_open_pr_source). Edits live ONLY in run_tick.py; siblings consumed unchanged.
